if last_transition:

    before_nodes = {n['id']: n for n in before_seg['nodes']}
    after_nodes = {n['id']: n for n in after_seg['nodes']}
    
    changed = []

        an = after_nodes.get(nid)

        elif bn['pixels'] != an['pixels'] or bn['color'] != an['color']:
            changed.append(f"Node {nid}: px {bn['pixels']}->{an['pixels']}, color {bn['color']}->{an['color']}")
        else:
            # Check position
            bcols = [p[1] for p in bn['boundary']]
            acols = [p[1] for p in an['boundary']]
            brows = [p[0] for p in bn['boundary']]
            arows = [p[0] for p in an['boundary']]
            if bcols != acols or brows != arows:
                changed.append(f"Node {nid}: moved r{min(brows)}-{max(brows)} c{min(bcols)}-{max(bcols)} -> r{min(arows)}-{max(arows)} c{min(acols)}-{max(acols)}")
    
    if changed:
        print("Changed nodes:")
        for c in changed:
            print(f"  {c}")
    else:
        print("No changes detected!")

</function>
